intro_server: The OHDSI standardized vocabularies (an ATHENA export) the server searches, browses and resolves concept sets with.
intro_browser: The OHDSI standardized vocabularies (an ATHENA export) loaded into this browser. They stay on this computer: nothing is sent anywhere.
import_server_description: Upload the files of an ATHENA download, or read them from a folder on the server.
import_browser_description: Pick the folder of an ATHENA download: it is loaded into this browser.
upload_hint: Choose the unzipped ATHENA folder (tab-separated CSV or Parquet). Required: {{tables}}.
browser_hint: Choose the unzipped ATHENA folder (tab-separated CSV or Parquet). Required: {{tables}}. Large tables are reduced to what the dictionary needs.
choose_hint: Release {{release}}. A vocabulary already held at the same version is left unticked.
not_persisted: Loaded, but not saved in this browser
not_persisted_hint: The browser refused the storage space: the vocabulary will be gone when this tab closes.
browser_filtered: Relationships and synonyms are kept for the dictionary's concepts only.
browser_unfiltered: Relationships and synonyms are kept in full.
browser_restore_failed: A vocabulary was saved in this browser but could not be restored. Import it again.
empty_description: Import an ATHENA export to search concepts, browse their hierarchy and resolve concept sets.
empty_reader: An administrator has not imported the OHDSI vocabularies yet.
status_error: Could not read the vocabulary status
remove_description: Its concepts can no longer be searched or resolved until it is imported again.
remove_browser_description: The vocabulary is removed from this browser; import the ATHENA folder again to use it.
remove_error: The vocabulary could not be removed
unavailable_description: Concept details need the OHDSI vocabularies: import them in Settings → Vocabularies.
concept_not_found: Concept {{id}} is not in the loaded vocabulary.
related_browser_note: In this browser, relationships are kept for the dictionary's concepts only.
hierarchy_truncated: Large hierarchy: showing the {{count}} nearest concepts.
